forecast_2026.tax_rate_rationale: Blended synthetic cash-tax sensitivity convention, not statutory legal tax determination; compare 20/25/30 percent.
forecast_2026.depreciation_convention: Full month of service for new assets; acquired legacy asset depreciation prorated by ownership days. This is an explicit model convention.
forecast_2026.mine_displaced_cost_credit_rationale: Conservative incremental interface scenario adds new service invoices and origin line-haul. No avoided external carrier cost or procurement saving is asserted.

nwc_forecast_drivers.rationale: Modest price/cost-index working capital growth; customer timing and supplier payment schedules carry these explicit balances.

forecast_2026.tax_timing_policy: Cumulative annual taxable income equals cumulative book pretax income less 180-month amortization of separately derived $13M tax goodwill basis, beginning with the full January acquisition month. Current tax settlements occur at modeled quarter ends; overpayments remain receivables, with no instant refund. Positive annual forecast supports temporary recognition and later reversal of interim tax-loss DTA. Reserve DTA persists because no ARU reserve settlement is modeled; goodwill tax amortization creates a separate DTL. This scenario payment convention is not a statutory return/payment calendar.
forecast_2026.external_volume_growth_boundary: Volume index changes invoice economics with the declared fixed cost budget. Nonzero volume sensitivities require operations capacity review; no automatic cost scalability or committed demand is asserted.

aro_successor.rationale: Carry locked acquisition ARO forward without invented offsets; calibrate explicit early/late settlement timing to opening liability. This demonstrates arithmetic consistency but does not claim independent engineering cost validation.

legal_book_policy.pale_sun_service_terms: Cost-based platform services within the original $2.8M aggregate G&A; paid monthly; eliminates at consolidation. Not an additional mine expense.
legal_book_policy.treasury_policy: Customers and suppliers use a centralized treasury pool. Legal ownership shares generate disclosed reciprocal current accounts; current-account financing is not revenue. Separately allocated opening subsidiary capital is the parent investment basis and eliminates at group consolidation.
legal_book_policy.limitation: Shared balance ownership is an explicit synthetic allocation, not an asserted appraisal or bank statement. Revenue and payroll preserve contract/employee segment ownership.
legal_book_policy.retention_and_consulting_allocation: Only Seth Kettering retention is allocated to BST using his share of the service pool; Fred Tolman consulting belongs entirely to ARU direct corporate costs. No fraction of consulting is inferred from a retention award.

working_capital_support.receivable_basis: Ledger receivables are net. A separately disclosed $80,000 older disputed balance for fictional ARU-C-025 is fully reserved at every modeled opening/closing date; no new provision, recovery or writeoff is modeled. Remaining balances are assumed collectible. Stable aging allocations support the selected NWC case, not an asserted customer invoice aging file or independently validated expected-loss estimate.
working_capital_support.inventory_basis: Synthetic consumable inventory at weighted average cost, allocated 50/20/30 percent to parts/fuel/materials. Equivalent quantities are value divided by explicit blended unit assumptions, not asserted stock counts or current market quotes. Zero obsolescence reserve assumes serviceable stocks; a write-down sensitivity must reduce assets and earnings explicitly.

acquisition_tax_allocation.basis_policy: Separate modeled adjusted grossed-up basis: $48M stock basis plus $20M recognized assumed liabilities, excluding $2.35M environmental/claim liabilities pending economic performance. Deduct $55M other tax asset bases to derive $13M tax goodwill independently of book goodwill. Finance leases are conditionally treated as tax-owned property with $2.5M basis; net AR tax basis aligns with its $6M book amount under the assumed specific disputed-debt treatment. Buyer transaction costs have zero modeled addition to target deemed-purchase basis; parent tax treatment is outside the group tax forecast. These classifications are conditional model assumptions, not a filed asset-allocation certificate.
acquisition_tax_allocation.future_reserve_treatment: No ARU reserve settlement occurs in 2026. Future settlements require redetermined assumed-liability recognition, AGUB/asset allocation and tax amortization. The reserve DTA assumes eventual recovery through additional deductible basis, not an automatic immediate deduction on settlement.
acquisition_tax_allocation.initial_goodwill_accounting: The $1.7625M initial book goodwill excess over tax basis is separately identified. No opening DTL is recognized for this initial excess under the modeled goodwill initial-recognition treatment. Subsequent tax amortization of the independent $13M basis creates a DTL. This is an explicit conditional accounting judgment, not an audited FASB conclusion.
